nodes.label: Polished Deepslate Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style polished deepslate texture. Medium-dark grey stone surface with subtle horizontal and diagonal layering lines suggesting the slate-like cleavage of deepslate. Slightly lighter than polished blackstone, with a cool grey-blue tint. Color palette: dark grey (#3A3A3A), medium grey (#484848), slightly lighter grey (#505050) with faint blue-grey undertones. Game purpose: decorative polished variant of deepslate found deep underground (below Y=0); used for sleek, dark architectural builds; requires a pickaxe to mine.
nodes.pattern: layered grey stone pattern with subtle directional grain lines
